description: The agent must: (1) Read `elixir-performance-review/SKILL.md` to understand the review checklist, valid patterns, and context-sensitive thresholds. (2) Read all four referenced files in `elixir-performance-review/references/`. (3) Read `review-verification-protocol/SKILL.md` as instructed by the skill before submitting findings. (4) Analyze all 5 `.ex` source files in `finpay/lib/finpay/`. (5) Correctly FLAG: `transaction_router.ex` for GenServer bottleneck (5000 req/sec >> 1000 threshold + blocking HTTP in handle_call → `genserver_bottleneck`) and unsupervised Task.async (→ `concurrency`); `rate_cache.ex` for GenServer used as read-heavy concurrent cache (95% reads, concurrent access = read:write > 10:1 AND concurrent → should use ETS, flag as `genserver_bottleneck`); `report_generator.ex` for Enum.map on 150k records (>> 10k threshold → `memory`) and unbounded spawn() per record (→ `concurrency`). (6) Correctly SUPPRESS false positives: `config_loader.ex` must NOT be flagged as a GenServer bottleneck (only ~5 req/sec, far below 1000 threshold — explicitly a valid pattern); `small_batch_processor.ex` must NOT be flagged for Enum usage (200 items << 10k threshold — Enum over small collections is explicitly valid). (7) Output `performance_review.json` with top-level `review_verified: true` (from review-verification-protocol), and each finding must include all required fields: `file`, `line` (integer), `severity` (one of critical/high/medium/low), `category` (one of genserver_bottleneck/memory/concurrency/database), `description`, `recommendation`, `verified: true`.
